summary: Grimmjow is Adjucas. The part of CFYOW you're referring to is when Hikone summons Ikomikidomoe, and Grimmjow says its power was enough to take out multiple Vasto Lorde-class Arrancars. This group consists of Harribel, Nel, and Grimmjow, the only survivors from the Espada besides the Privaron.
